versions.subject: Merge PR #4682 from @jstnk9 - Add new rules related to MODE.COM usage in changing code pages
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\mode.com'
    - OriginalFileName: 'MODE.COM'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' con '
        - ' cp '
        - ' select='
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\mode.com" OR OriginalFileName="MODE.COM" CommandLine="* con *" CommandLine="* cp *" CommandLine="* select=*"
